name: calendar-01
title: Calendar 01 - A Month Grid Of Scheduled Items
description: A month of scheduled work: the published mini-calendar for the month, the locale, the weekday headings and the paging, and the caller's items grouped under the days they fall on. The cap of three items a day exists because a month grid with nine items on one day is a month grid nobody can read, and the overflow line is always drawn and always in the caller's own words, because a day that looks complete and is not is the one failure a calendar may not have. The tone is the Status tone and the words beside it are required. Every string is passed in as a prop.
